newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan PM to meet MOF minister on financial reforms.
newsitem.headline: Japan PM to meet MOF minister on financial reforms.

text.p: Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto is expected to meet Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka at around 3.30 p.m. (0630 GMT) on Monday and call for drastic reform of Japan's financial system, a government official told Reuters.
Justice Minister Isao Matsuura will also be asked by Hashimoto to attend the meeting, the official said.

However, the official said Hashimoto would ask for drastic reforms of the financial system and that the reforms were likely to encourage foreign investors to direct their securities investment to Japan.
